'''Roberta Sessoli''' is Professor of General and [[Inorganic chemistry|Inorganic Chemistry]] in the Department of [[Chemistry]] "[[Hugo Schiff|Ugo Schiff]]" at the [[University of Florence]]. Renowned as a pioneer in the field of magnetic bistability and [[quantum effects]] in [[Mesoscopic physics|mesoscopic]] materials, her research centers around investigating the magnetic properties of molecular clusters and chains, with a focus on designing and characterizing [[Molecule-based magnet|molecular magnetic materials]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Chemistry Views |url=https://www.chemistryviews.org/60th-birthday-roberta-sessoli/}}</ref>

== Education and early career ==
Roberta Sessoli was born in Florence on the 23 June 1963.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|url=https://www.urp.cnr.it/copertine/formazione/form_concorsi/CV_Commissari/CV%20Sessoli%20Roberta.pdf|title=Curriculum Vitae di Roberta Sessoli|last=Sessoli|first=Roberta}}</ref> She attended [[Liceo scientifico|Liceo Scientifico]] [[Guido Castelnuovo]] in Florence.<ref name=":2">{{Cite journal|date=2009-03-16|title=Roberta Sessoli|journal=Angewandte Chemie International Edition|volume=48|issue=13|pages=2265|doi=10.1002/anie.200900389|issn=1521-3773}}</ref> She graduated in [[Chemistry]] from the [[University of Florence]] in 1987. In 1992, she obtained her PhD from the same university, under the supervision of Professor Dante Gatteschi.<ref name=":2" /> She conducted a part of her studies at the Institut d’Electronique Fondamentale – [[Paris-Sud University|Université Paris-Sud]], [[France]]. Her PhD thesis was on "Molecular Magnetic Materials" (original title in Italian: "Materiali Magnetici Molecolari").<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.unifi.it/p-doc2-2015-0-A-2b333a2e3b2a-1.html|title=Roberta Sessoli - Università degli Studi di Firenze - UniFI|website=www.unifi.it|language=it|access-date=2019-02-15}}</ref>

== Research interests ==
Sessoli began working at the University of Florence in 2000, and became full Professor of General and [[Inorganic chemistry|Inorganic Chemistry]] in the Department of [[Chemistry]] "[[Hugo Schiff|Ugo Schiff]]" at the [[University of Florence]] in 2012.<ref name=":0"/> She has been an invited professor at [[Pierre and Marie Curie University|Pierre & Marie Curie University]], [[Paris]], in 2001, and at [[University of Otago|Otago University]], [[New Zealand]], in 2017. From 2018 to 2019, she was awarded a visiting professorship at [[University of Mainz|Gutenberg University]] in [[Mainz]], [[Germany]].

Sessoli is interested in molecular and low-dimensional magnetism. She also worked on the spin dynamics of nanostructured materials. She investigated the nature of [[Single-molecule magnet|single molecules magnets]].<ref name=erc12>{{Cite web|url=https://erc.europa.eu/projects-figures/stories/when-molecules-become-magnets-%E2%80%93roberta-sessoli-alla-giornata-informativa|title=When molecules become magnets –Roberta Sessoli alla giornata informativa dedicata all'ERC|date=2012-06-22|website=ERC: European Research Council|access-date=2019-02-15}}</ref> Part of her research also focusses on [[Quantum|quantistic]] technologies and [[Spintronics|spintronic]] molecular materials. More recently, her studies concentrated on  the characterization of magnetic materials through the use of [[Polarization (waves)|unpolarised light]].<ref name=rogalev15>{{Cite journal |last1=Rogalev |first1=Andrei |last2=Wilhelm |first2=Fabrice |last3=Poggini |first3=Lorenzo |last4=Mannini |first4=Matteo |last5=Caneschi |first5=Andrea |last6=Boulon |first6=Marie-Emmanuelle |last7=Sessoli |first7=Roberta |date=January 2015 |title=Strong magneto-chiral dichroism in a paramagnetic molecular helix observed by hard X-rays |journal=Nature Physics |volume=11 |issue=1 |pages=69–74 |doi=10.1038/nphys3152 |pmid=25729401 |pmc=4340522 |issn=1745-2481 |bibcode=2015NatPh..11...69S}}</ref> She uses a range of characterization techniques such as [[Magnetometer|magnetometry]], [[electron paramagnetic resonance]], [[X-ray diffraction]], and X-ray absorption.

== Publications ==
Sessoli's most influential publication is "Magnetic bistability in a metal-ion cluster", published in [[Nature (journal)|''Nature'']] in 1993 only one year after the completion of her PhD. This was a particularly influential article in the field of molecular magnetism, and was co-authored with Dante Gatteschi, Andrea Caneschi and Miguel A. Novak.<ref name=":1">{{Cite journal|last1=Novak|first1=M. A.|last2=A. Caneschi|last3=Gatteschi|first3=D.|last4=Sessoli|first4=R.|date=September 1993|title=Magnetic bistability in a metal-ion cluster|journal=Nature|volume=365|issue=6442|pages=141–143|doi=10.1038/365141a0|issn=1476-4687|bibcode=1993Natur.365..141S|s2cid=4235125}}</ref> Since then the article has received more than 2770 citations.<ref name=":1" /> In 2018, Sessoli was nominated as one of the most highly cited researchers by Clarivate Analytics.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://hcr.clarivate.com/|title=Highly Cited Researchers - The Most Influential Scientific Minds|website=HCR|access-date=2019-02-15|archive-date=2019-02-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190220122703/https://hcr.clarivate.com/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Sessoli co-authored the book "Molecular Nanomagnets" with Dante Gatteschi and Jacques Villain, which was published by Oxford University Press in 2006.<ref name=villain06>{{Cite book|title=Molecular Nanomagnets|last1=Villain|first1=Jacques|last2=Sessoli|first2=Roberta|last3=Gatteschi|first3=Dante|date=2006-03-02|publisher=Oxford University Press|isbn=9780191718298|doi=10.1093/acprof:oso/9780198567530.001.0001}}</ref>

== Awards ==
For her work in chemistry, Sessoli received a wide range of awards: 
*2000 Medaglia Nasini for best young inorganic chemist in Italy<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.inorg.it/awards.html|title=Albo d'Oro, premi e premiati|website=www.inorg.it|access-date=2019-02-15}}</ref>
*2002 Gonfalone d’argento from the [[Regional council (Italy)|Regional Council]] of [[Tuscany]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www1.adnkronos.com/Archivio/AdnAgenzia/2002/09/09/Cultura/SCIENZIATI-PREMIATI-GATTESCHI-E-SESSOLI-PER-NUOVA-SCOPERTA_141400.php|title=SCIENZIATI: PREMIATI GATTESCHI E SESSOLI PER NUOVA SCOPERTA|website=www1.adnkronos.com|access-date=2019-02-16}}</ref>
*2002 [[Agilent Technologies]] Europhysics Prize<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.investor.agilent.com/news-releases/news-release-details/agilent-technologies-presents-europhysics-prize-pioneering-work|title=Agilent Technologies Presents Europhysics Prize for Pioneering Work on Quantum Behavior of Molecular Nanomagnets|website=Agilent Technologies Inc.|access-date=2019-02-16|archive-date=2019-03-06|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190306235157/https://www.investor.agilent.com/news-releases/news-release-details/agilent-technologies-presents-europhysics-prize-pioneering-work|url-status=dead}}</ref>
*2012 Beller lectureship of the [[American Physical Society]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/publications/apsnews/201202/bellermarshak.cfm|title=Four Distinguished Scientists to Give Beller, Marshak Lectures|website=www.aps.org|access-date=2019-02-16}}</ref>
*2013 French-Italian Prize from [[Société chimique de France|Société Chimique de France]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.societechimiquedefrance.fr/Franco-Italien.html?lang=fr|title=Société Chimique de France|website=www.societechimiquedefrance.fr|access-date=2019-02-16|archive-date=2019-09-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190921003335/http://www.societechimiquedefrance.fr/Franco-Italien.html?lang=fr|url-status=dead}}</ref>
*2013 Linceo Prize for Chemistry from [[Accademia dei Lincei|Accademia Nazionale dei Lincei]]<ref name=":4">{{Cite web|url=http://vis.sns.it/roberta-sessoli-10febbraio2016-chimica/|title=Roberta Sessoli 10/febbraio/2016 Chimica {{!}} VIS|language=it-IT|access-date=2019-02-15|archive-date=2016-06-01|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160601191041/http://vis.sns.it/roberta-sessoli-10febbraio2016-chimica/|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name=":5">{{Cite web|url=http://www.lincei.it/files/documenti/Premiati_2013.pdf|title=Premi Accademia dei Lincei 2013}}</ref>
*2015 [[Lecoq de Boisbaudran Award]] from the [[European Rare Earths Society]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://axial.acs.org/2018/11/15/inorganic-chemistry-and-organometallics-welcome-new-associate-editors/|title=Inorganic Chemistry and Organometallics Welcome New Associate Editors|date=2018-11-15|website=ACS Axial|access-date=2019-02-16}}</ref>
*2015 Fiorino d’oro from [[Florence]] City Council<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.lanazione.it/firenze/cronaca/foto/fiorino-doro-1.1089195|title=Fiorino d'oro della Città di Firenze, la consegna a Palazzo Vecchio|last=Nazione|first=La|website=La Nazione|language=it|access-date=2019-02-16}}</ref>
*2015 [[International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry|IUPAC]] Distinguished Women in Chemistry award<ref name=":6">{{Cite journal|date=2015|title=IUPAC 2015 Distinguished Women in Chemistry or Chemical Engineering|journal=Angewandte Chemie International Edition|volume=54|issue=30|pages=8593|doi=10.1002/anie.201505537|issn=1521-3773}}</ref>
*2017 Visiting Professorship at the [[University of Otago|Otago University]], [[New Zealand]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://blogs.otago.ac.nz/brooker/visitors-2/|title=Visitors {{!}} Brooker's Bunch|website=blogs.otago.ac.nz|access-date=2019-02-16}}</ref>
*2018-2019 Visiting Professorship at the [[Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.lamm.unifi.it/vp-129-roberta-sessoli.html|title=Roberta Sessoli - LaMM's Staff - LaMM: Laboratorio di Magnetismo Molecolare - UniFI|website=www.lamm.unifi.it|access-date=2019-02-16}}</ref>
*2019 [[Royal Society of Chemistry|RSC]] Centenary Prize for world-leading research on molecular magnetism<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.rsc.org/ScienceAndTechnology/Awards/CentenaryPrizes/2019-Winner-Sessoli.asp|title=RSC Centenary Prize 2019 Winner|website=www.rsc.org|access-date=2019-06-20}}</ref>
*2023 Honorary Doctorate from the University of Barcelona<ref>{{Cite web |title=University of Barcelona |url=https://web.ub.edu/en/web/actualitat/w/la-ub-investeix-doctora-honoris-causa-roberta-sessoli-pionera-en-la-recerca-sobre-magnetisme-molecular}}</ref>

== Family and personal life ==
Sessoli has three sons: Lapo, Corso and Vieri.<ref name=":3" />

The fire station in via [[La Farina]] in Florence is named after Sessoli's grandfather, Giuseppe Sessoli, who was a fireman during the Second World War and died trying to save a woman and a little girl who were on a mined bridge.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.vigilfuoco.it/sitiVVF/firenze/viewPage.aspx?s=1221&p=7183|title=Storia del Comando Prov.le di Firenze|website=www.vigilfuoco.it|access-date=2019-02-15}}</ref>
